ModMetaData.name: ProgressionLESS: Hives
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
All the Progression goodness, less research.
Overhauls hive research, so each Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids 2 hive building has a place in the research tree.
The "LESS" is less research: Progression: Hives adds up to 34 research projects depending on your mods. This fork groups them into at most 9, such as Hive growths, Geneline hives and Hive organs. Everything stays in the same era, and still needs the other research it did before.
Forked from Progression: Hives by ferny. Huge thanks to ferny for the original mod and all the Progression work this builds on. Replaces the original; do not use both.
For a really good modpack, check out The Progression Modpack on the Steam Workshop.
